Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Interface PbcsExplicitDimensionsPlanType

All Superinterfaces:
PbcsObject, PbcsPlanType
All Known Implementing Classes:
PbcsExplicitDimensionsPlanTypeImpl
public interface PbcsExplicitDimensionsPlanType extends PbcsPlanType
A specialization of a normal plan type that has been created with explicitly defined dimensions. There are still a handful of methods in the parent interface that need to be 'moved' over to this one since they are unsupported in a plan type without explicit dimensions.

    • validateDimensions

      void validateDimensions()
      Validate the explicitly defined dimensions. Dimensions are checked by calling PbcsPlanType.getMember(String, String) using the dimension name for both parameters.
      Throws:
      PbcsInvalidDimensionException - if there is an invalid dimension.
